extracted.intended_audience: aspiring novelists and fiction writers aiming to write commercial/breakout (bestselling) novels
extracted.subtask_description: How-to guidance for conceiving, structuring, and polishing novels intended to 'break out' of category constraints and reach a large, mainstream readership; includes craft, premise generation, plot/character/Theme techniques, and marketplace strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create a powerful and sweeping sense of time and place
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish a convincing, sweeping sense of setting and era that supports broad appeal and anchors the novel's action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From summary: 'create a powerful and sweeping sense of time and place.' TOC subtopics: 'Time and Place', 'The Psychology of Place', 'Keeping Up With the Times', 'Working With Historical Forces and Social Trends', 'God at Work in the World', 'The Secret Ingredient'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop larger-than-life characters
rubrics_metrics.description: Create characters who feel bigger than ordinary people — distinctive, memorable, and emotionally compelling — to carry a novel to breakout status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From summary: 'develop larger-than-life characters.' TOC: 'Characters', 'Real People vs. Larger-Than-Life Figures', 'What Makes a Character Larger-Than-Life?', 'Dark Protagonists', 'The Highest Character Qualities', 'Building a Cast', 'Advanced Character Relationships', 'Sidekicks and Narrators', 'Depth and Differentiation of Character'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustain a high degree of narrative tension from start to finish
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain escalating stakes and continuous narrative pressure throughout the book so readers stay urgently invested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From summary: 'sustain a high degree of narrative tension from start to finish.' TOC emphasis: 'Stakes', 'Escalating Stakes', 'Tension on Every Page', 'What is the Worst That Can Happen?', 'High Moments, Turning Corners, Killing Characters'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Weave sub-plots into the main action
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrate subplots so they enhance the central plot, deepen theme and character, and maintain momentum rather than distract.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From summary: 'weave sub-plots into the main action.' TOC: 'Multiple Viewpoints, Subplots, Pace, Voice, Endings' and separate 'Successful Subplots'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explore universal themes that will interest a large audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose and develop themes with broad human resonance — 'something to say' that connects across readers and categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From summary: 'explore universal themes that will interest a large audience of readers.' TOC: 'Theme', 'Having Something to Say', 'Step-by-Step Theme Building', 'What Makes a Theme Universal?', 'Discovering Theme', 'The Protagonist's Declaration of Purpose', 'Right and Wrong in the Novel', 'Symbols', 'Becoming Passionate'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Premise (breakout premise development)
rubrics_metrics.description: Find and build a breakout premise — the central idea that will allow the novel to rise out of its category and reach a wide readership.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entries: 'Premise', 'The Little Components of Big Ideas', 'Build It and the Breakout Premise Will Come', 'Brainstorming the Breakout Premise', 'Four Facets of Three Great Novels', 'The Stories That You Love' — guidance centers on identifying, assembling, and testing the key components that make a premise breakout-capable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create high human worth and layered stakes
rubrics_metrics.description: Design stakes which combine public and personal consequences so the reader cares deeply and the plot keeps escalating.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC subtopics under Stakes: 'Creating High Human Worth', 'Public Stakes', 'Personal Stakes', 'Escalating Stakes', 'Your Own Stakes' — emphasizes human importance, escalation, and personal investment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time, cultural context and trend-awareness
rubrics_metrics.description: Use setting, historical forces and social trends to amplify relevance; keep the book 'in time' with cultural currents without dating it unnecessarily.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC: 'Time and Place', 'The Psychology of Place', 'Keeping Up With the Times', 'Working With Historical Forces and Social Trends', 'God at Work in the World', 'The Secret Ingredient' — guidance on leveraging zeitgeist and place as narrative fuel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character type and moral complexity (including dark protagonists)
rubrics_metrics.description: Decide whether characters will be realistic or larger-than-life and whether to employ morally complex or 'dark' protagonists to generate interest and tension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC: 'Real People vs. Larger-Than-Life Figures', 'What Makes a Character Larger-Than-Life?', 'Dark Protagonists', 'The Highest Character Qualities' — covers choice of character scale and moral choices as craft decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Casting and relationships (ensemble building)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assemble a cast with differentiated roles and layered relationships (sidekicks, narrators, advanced relationships) that serve both plot and theme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC: 'Building a Cast', 'Advanced Character Relationships', 'Sidekicks and Narrators', 'Depth and Differentiation of Character'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict and the five basic plot elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Anchor the novel in strong, escalating conflict structured around core plot elements that create momentum and reveal character.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC: 'Plot', 'Conflict', 'The Five Basic Plot Elements', 'Bridging Conflict', 'What is the Worst That Can Happen?'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design high moments, turning points, and lethal consequences
rubrics_metrics.description: Plan pivotal 'high moments', dramatic turning corners and (where appropriate) character deaths or severe consequences to heighten impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC: 'High Moments, Turning Corners, Killing Characters' — guidance on placing and using climactic and consequential events for maximum effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structuring plot and advanced plot architectures
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose and shape an overarching structure (traditional or inventive) that organizes rising action, payoffs and thematic arcs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC: 'Structuring Plot', 'Larger Plot Structures', 'Advanced Plot Structures', 'The New Shape of the Novel', 'Inventing Your Own Advanced Plot Structure', 'The Character-Driven Story', 'Self-Discovery in the Plot-Driven Novel', 'Nonlinear Narrative'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tension on every page
rubrics_metrics.description: Make each page deliver some degree of tension—emotional, situational, or question-driven—so the reading experience remains urgent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC explicitly lists 'Tension on Every Page' as a craft imperative; linked to stakes, pacing, and scene design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple viewpoints and narrative choices
rubrics_metrics.description: Use multiple POVs, narrators or voices strategically to expand scope, deepen character, or create suspense without confusing the reader.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC: 'Multiple Points of View', 'Multiple Viewpoints, Subplots, Pace, Voice, Endings' — emphasizes careful management of POV multiplicity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Successful subplots and integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Create subplots that support theme and main action, escalate stakes, and provide emotional/structural variety.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC: 'Successful Subplots' and summary: 'weave sub-plots into the main action.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative pace
rubrics_metrics.description: Control pacing to balance momentum with necessary development — accelerate through action, slow for reflection — to maintain reader engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entries: 'Narrative Pace', 'Pace' (within 'Multiple Viewpoints, Subplots, Pace, Voice, Endings').

rubrics_metrics.name: Voice
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop a distinctive narrative voice that fits the material and sets the book apart in the marketplace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC: 'Voice' and its listing with pace and endings; voice is treated as a crucial differentiator for breakout potential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Endings
rubrics_metrics.description: Craft an ending that satisfies both plot and thematic promises and reinforces the novel's breakout qualities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC: 'Endings' (also included with multiple viewpoints/pace/voice).

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre and category strategies (thrillers, crossover, historicals, romance, linked stories)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adapt craft and premise for specific genre opportunities or cross-category appeal to expand potential readership.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC: 'Thrillers', 'Crossover Fiction', 'Whole Life', 'Historicals', 'Out-of-Category Romance', 'Linked Short Stories', 'Families, Groups, Generations' — guidance on genre-specific tactics and crossover possibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Theme building and symbolic layering
rubrics_metrics.description: Systematically build and reveal theme through symbols, character declarations and moral frameworks so the book says something universal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC: 'Theme', 'Having Something to Say', 'Step-by-Step Theme Building', 'Symbols', 'Right and Wrong in the Novel', 'The Protagonist's Declaration of Purpose', 'What Makes a Theme Universal?', 'Discovering Theme'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pitching, agents, editors and the marketplace
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare the work and its presentation (pitch, outline) to attract agents and editors and to position the novel for breakout success.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC: 'Breaking Out', 'Agent and Editor', 'The Pitch', 'Outlines', 'Breakout Publishing, Breakout Living', 'Success, Sequels, Series and Beyond' — covers marketing, pitching, and career strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Idea generation and brainstorming
rubrics_metrics.description: Use systematic brainstorming and analysis of 'little components' to generate strong breakout ideas and evaluate premises.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC: 'Brainstorming the Breakout Premise', 'The Little Components of Big Ideas', 'Four Facets of Three Great Novels', 'Build It and the Breakout Premise Will Come', 'The Stories That You Love'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career planning: sequels, series and long-term breakout living
rubrics_metrics.description: Plan beyond a single book: understand sequels, series potential and how breakout success can be managed as a career.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC: 'Breakout Publishing, Breakout Living', 'Success, Sequels, Series and Beyond' — advice on life and career after breakout success.
